description: Browser-Based Tools Show Current and Historical Crop Cover and Health is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by George Mason University | Center for Spatial Information and Science Systems; NASA, National Aeronautics and Space Administration; USDA National Agricultural Statistics Service. To manage their businesses successfully, farmers and food production companies need to know what crops are in the ground and how well they are growing. A pair of easy-to-use online mapping tools provides this information for growing seasons in the past and present. Coverage: the United States (2014). The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
